note: Superior NF campground on Kimball Lake, a small state-managed trout lake (a trout stamp is needed to fish it), about 12 miles north of Grand Marais off the Gunflint Trail on FR 140 (Trout Lake Road). Wooded pull-in sites, not designed for RVs: the Forest Service says most take a moderately sized vehicle and some may not suit an RV. A trail circles the lake; adjacent Mink Lake has a sand swimming beach and an accessible fishing pier. --Claude
